title: Maximum speed condition
description: Essential: Student must state or use that the final speed after both acceleration phases is 40 m/s.

title: Second phase calculation
description: Important: Student correctly applies v = u + at to the second phase (a₂ = 2 m/s², t₂ = 10 s) to find v₁.

title: First phase calculation
description: Important: Student correctly applies v = u + at to the first phase (starting from rest, t₁ = 5 s) to find a₁ using v₁.

title: Correct final answers
description: Essential: Student provides both final numerical answers: v₁ = 20 m/s and a₁ = 4 m/s².

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student includes correct units (m/s and m/s²) with numerical answers.

title: Sign error in kinematics
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses negative acceleration or misapplies sign in v = u + at equations.

title: Phase transition confusion
description: Pitfall: Student treats the motion as one continuous acceleration or incorrectly combines time intervals.
